name: @artifactbin/sql
description: The SQL service: SQLite (the official wasm build), in this process or in one of its own. Rows in, rows out; nothing persists between calls. `.` is the contract, the HTTP client and the server shell; `./core` is the browser-safe SQLite engine; `./testing` is the in-thread SqlService fixture (also available at the legacy `./sqlite` path); `./local` is the same engine in a pool of worker threads, for a server.
